info.title: MeshDB Data API
info.description:
Programmatic access to mesh core data, detailing our installs, members, etc. 

To use an authorization token, use the "Authorize" button, and under "tokenAuth" enter `Token ` before the content of your token, like this: `Token xxxyyyyyzzz`

If you have username/password credentials (like those used on the admin UI) you can login via the admin UI or [DRF login page](/auth/login/?next=/api-docs/swagger/)

get.description:
This endpoint can be used by clients to determine the health status of this API. This API always
returns 200 status codes, accepts no input, and has no side effects. It always returns the
string "We're meshin'."

200.description: API is up and serving traffic

Building.description:
A  ModelSerializer MixIn which sets `NestedKeyObjectRelatedField` as the default field class
to use for the foreign key fields

items.description: A reference to a Install object, via one or more of the following keys: ['id', 'install_number']

bin.description: NYC DOB Identifier for the structure containing this building

street_address.description: Line 1 only of the address of this building: i.e. <house num> <street>

city.description: The name of the borough this building is in for buildings within NYC, "New York" for Manhattan to match street addresses. The actual city name for anything outside NYC

state.description: The 2 letter abreviation of the US State this building is contained within, e.g. "NY" or "NJ"

zip_code.description: The five digit ZIP code this building is contained within

address_truth_sources.description: A list of strings that answers the question: How was the content of the street address, city, state, and ZIP fields determined? This is useful in understanding the level of validation applied to spreadsheet imported data. Possible values are: OSMNominatim, OSMNominatimZIPOnly, NYCPlanningLabs, PeliasStringParsing, ReverseGeocodeFromCoordinates, HumanEntry. Check the import script for details

altitude.description: Building rooftop altitude in "absolute" meters above mean sea level

notes.description: A free-form text description of this building, to track any additional information. For Buidings imported from the spreadsheet, this starts with a formatted block of information about the import process and original spreadsheet data. However this structure can be changed by admins at any time and should not be relied on by automated systems.

panoramas.description: Panoramas taken from the roof of this Building

primary_node.description: The primary node for this Building, for cases where it has more than one. This is the node bearing the network number that the building is collquially referred to by volunteers and is usually the first NN held by any equipment on the building. If present, this must also be included in nodes

nodes.description: All nodes located on the same structure (i.e. a discrete man-made place identified by the same BIN) that this Building is located within.

exact_match_install.description: An install  with the install number exactly matching the requested number, if that install has NOT had its install number recycled (or null if none exists)

exact_match_node.description: A Node with the network number exactly matching the requested number, if it exists

ticket_number.description: The ticket number of the OSTicket used to track communications with the member about this install. Note that although this appears to be an integer, it is not. Leading zeros are important, so this should be stored as a string at all times

stripe_subscription_id.description: The Stripe.com Subscription ID for the monthly contributions associated with this install. The presence of a subscription id here does not imply an active subscription, to determine if a subscription is active, one must contact Stripe directly with this identifier

install_date.description: The date this install was completed and deployed to the mesh

additional_members.description: Any additional members associated with this install. E.g. roommates, parents, caretakers etc. Anyone that might contact us on behalf of this install belongs here

tags.name: Members
tags.description: Members of the mesh and their contact details

tags.name: Buildings
tags.description: Buildings on the mesh and their location data, one per street address

tags.name: Installs
tags.description: Installs, one corresponding to each household that is either already on the mesh, or wishes to join the mesh. For convenience this category offers two different methods to access the same database objects. Either database UUID or install_number can be used interchanably in any of the URLs for this object

tags.name: Nodes
tags.description: Nodes, one corresponding to each collection of devices with the same network number, the installs that use those devices, and the buildings that house them. For convenience this category offers two different methods to access the same database objects. Either database UUID or network_number can be used interchanably in any of the URLs for this object. Note that not all Nodes have a network_number (that field is only required for active nodes)

tags.name: LOSes
tags.description: Lines of sight between buildings, primarily useful to document potential future links

tags.name: Devices
tags.description: Devices, one corresponding to each physical device on the mesh (routers, aps, cpes, etc.). Includes all Sectors and Access Points

tags.name: Sectors
tags.description: Special devices with antennas with broad coverage of a radial "slice" of land area. See https://wiki.nycmesh.net/books/3-hardware-firmware/page/ubiquiti-liteap-sector#bkmrk-page-title

tags.name: Access Points
tags.description: Special devices which provide community WiFi to a given area, usually in a park or other public place

tags.name: Billing
tags.description: Billing data, such as for invoices of install fees to large institutions

tags.name: Geographic & KML Data
tags.description: Endpoints for geographic and KML data export

tags.name: Website Map Data
tags.description: Endpoints used to power the nycmesh.net website map. Uses a legacy data format, not recommended for new applications

tags.name: Legacy Query Form
tags.description: Endpoints used to power the legacy docs query form. Uses a legacy data format, not recommended for new applications

tags.name: Helpers
tags.description: Utilities to assist with misc tasks related to NYC Mesh data

tags.name: Panoramas
tags.description: Used to bulk ingest panoramas. Internal use only (use Building.panoramas instead)
